Plots of the growth-morph structure of an operating model

Source: R/gtg_plots.R
plot_gtg.Rd

  • plot_gtg_growth(): growth curves of the morphs (line width by recruitment share) and the mean VB curve.

  • plot_gtg_selectivity(): effective selectivity at age by fleet (fleet F at age / apical F) in the first and last years, against the selectivity at age of the age-based OM (FLRef::sel_la). Removing fast growers first lowers effective selectivity at older ages as fishing goes on.

  • plot_gtg_lenage(): mean length at age in the population and in each fleet's catch in one year, against the VB curve (Rosa Lee effect in the population; gear selection in the catch).

  • plot_gtg_lfq(): true catch-at-length by fleet (annual, summed over seasons), with the sampled length compositions on top when data is given (both as proportions).

  • plot_gtg_spr(): true equilibrium SPR by year from the morphs, with SPR at MSY of the morph equilibrium.

Usage

plot_gtg_growth(om)

plot_gtg_selectivity(om, iter = 1)

plot_gtg_lenage(om, iter = 1, year = NULL)

plot_gtg_lfq(
  om,
  data = NULL,
  iter = 1,
  years = NULL,
  oem = NULL,
  seasons = 12,
  season_weights = "catch"
)

plot_gtg_spr(om, iters = 1:3)

Arguments

om

a floss_om built with gtg.

iter, iters

iteration; iters (several iterations) for the ribbons.

year

year (default last OM year).

data

optional output of sample_data() or a data frame of length samples (sample_lfd()).

years

years to show (default the last four).

oem, seasons, season_weights

passed to gtg_lfq(); use season_weights = "equal" to compare with samples split equally over the seasons.

Value

a ggplot.
